title: Allah Janay Kadoon Mur Kay
body:
Allah janay kadoon mur kay awna ay Zahra jaiyaan, Shaam chaliyaan logo
<<DIVIDER>>
Veer di lash utoon, kha kay Jirkaan uthiyaan
Bhain Abbas diyaan, Roon kharhyaan logo
<<DIVIDER>>
Barishaan patharaan diyaan zalmoo rook lavo
Aey nabizadiayaan nay nazaan paliyaan logo
<<DIVIDER>>
Nal Qasam ve nahi, naeo Akbar bachiya
Kiwaan mustooran gaeyaan, Shaam kaliyaan logo
<<DIVIDER>>
Khari na mehrmaan wich, deway khutbay Zainab
Aik ik moar uttay, shawa dhuliyan Logo
<<DIVIDER>>
Baap day seenay tay, son di aadi nay
Sukhtyaan safraan diyaan, kinway jhuliyaan logo
